title: John Lydus, De ostentis (Περὶ διοσημειῶν; «О знамениях»)
author: John Lydus
ru_evidence: Tiny: Sinitsa translated only the introduction (chs. 1–8; Belgorod 2018) and ch. 71. Sinitsa–Bolgov (2022): «полных комментированных переводов – задача на будущее»
en_evidence: Bandy (ed.), The Works of Ioannes Lydus III: De ostentis (Edwin Mellen 2013), listed on ru.wikipedia
other_translations: An Italian edition/translation is mentioned in Sinitsa's survey; details not verified
value: Preserves Nigidius Figulus' Etruscan thunder calendar and lore from Fonteius, Labeo and Campestris. A prime source on Etruscan and Roman religion and ancient divination, for historians of religion and science.
ai_feasibility: High: clear Greek. Technical astro-meteorological terms need a glossary and comparison with the Latin sources
pilot_unit: The thunder calendar (brontoscopic calendar) chapters, est. 5k words
